subject: Re: Encord/Voxel - Renewal Alignment
text:
+ @Abhishek Venkataraman <abhishek@voxelai.com>

Thanks Alyssa.

   1. For project hours, I think 85,000 might be too high. Our current
   average monthly hours are about 3300 for the last 5 months. We may expect
   doubling the hours at the end of 12 months, but the ramp would be gradual
   (5-10% per month). Most of our labeling hours are for new
   customer onboarding and usually a one time effort for the new customer. Our
   per month new customer growth is currently pretty steady. Realistically, I
   think the total hours will not exceed 50,000 hours for the next 12 months.
   2. Voxel internal users - does the bot/integration user also count? Do
   active users and annotation users count differently? The active managers to
   the encord projects would be less than 5. Most current users are in the
   system either for FYI on their project status or to use Active platform.

thanks
Chang
